request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Recolour only the bright blue hide: it becomes a clear mid slate blue, colour #4a78b8 on the lit side with #2c4470 shadows, not grey and not bright, and dark navy #1a2748 only along the back, the top of the tail and the far leg. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest and back spikes, the cream belly, throat and lower jaw, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
